title: Combining Courtesy Bonus Awards by Harbison Products Held — Repair and Emergency Service Calls
content:
On a paid tune-up under Repair and Emergency Service Calls, how a courtesy-program customer's courtesy bonus awards reach the courtesy rate depends on how many Harbison products the customer holds. Four holdings are counted:

- an active agreement under Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements;
- a closed installation under Replacement System Installations;
- an active contract under Harbison Protection Contracts;
- an active subscription under FilterDirect Filter Subscriptions.

**Rule.**

| Harbison products held | Courtesy bonus awards added |
|---|---|
| 3 or 4 | Every bonus award |
| Exactly 2 | Only the two largest awards |
| 1 or none | No bonus award |

**Rate.** The points so combined are added to the courtesy rate, the call class's courtesy program percentage, before the discount is figured. In a call class where the courtesy program does not apply, no points are added.

## Worked examples (hypothetical customers, class courtesy rate 10 percent)

| Holdings | Awards earned | Points added | Courtesy rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Active agreement (9 consecutive terms), active FilterDirect subscription | 4, 3 and 2 | The two largest, 4 and 3, which is 7 | 17 percent |
| Active agreement, closed installation, active protection contract | 2, 3, 3 and 1 | Every award, 9 | 19 percent |
| Active FilterDirect subscription only | 3 | None | 10 percent |

In the first row the customer earns three awards but holds only two products, so only the two largest are added.
